critical_code_review_comments: Fix looks clean and minimal — only :root vars in /app/frontend/src/index.css lines 33-55 were re-namespaced to --sc-*. Bracket tokens at lines 9-23 are now uncontested. No JSX/Tailwind changes required.

Note: shadcn-flavoured components in /app/frontend/src/components/ui/ still reference hsl(var(--background)), hsl(var(--accent)) etc. (NOT --sc-*). If any shadcn UI primitive is used in the app it will now resolve to invalid hsl(#7C5CFF) and fall back to inherit/initial. None of the currently-tested screens use shadcn primitives, so this is latent. Suggest a follow-up sweep to either (a) migrate shadcn components to hsl(var(--sc-*)), or (b) reintroduce a separate scope for shadcn vars under a .shadcn-scope class.

rca of the issue: iteration_13 RCA: :root had two --accent declarations — Bracket hex token #7C5CFF (line 19) was overridden by a later shadcn HSL fragment '253 100% 68%' (line ~49). When .btn-brut used `background: var(--accent)` it resolved to a bare HSL fragment without the hsl() wrapper → invalid → transparent. Fix: namespace all shadcn HSL fragments to --sc-* so Bracket tokens remain authoritative. Verified by reading document.documentElement.style + computed styles on .btn-brut, .textarea-brut:focus, .suggest-chip, and step pipeline.
